frequency_question: How often do advanced defense localization efforts under severe structural friction achieve operational production within a short window?
membership_rule: Includes any sovereign state attempting to stand up domestic manufacturing/assembly lines for foreign-designed advanced cruise missiles or high-tech guided weapons under severe industrial friction or sanctions. Excludes standard licensed small arms or basic artillery production.

cases.name: Iran Soumar/Qods cruise missile reverse engineering and production
Ukraine Neptune missile domestic production setup
Argentina Condor missile project (canceled due to friction)
Iraq Al-Samoud / Babur missile production attempts under heavy sanctions

coverage_note: 7 named historical instances of advanced missile localization under severe structural friction; 5 achieved operational domestic production lines.
known_gaps: Classified or obscure domestic missile programs in smaller states may be under-reported.
validity_reason: Global proliferation of advanced manufacturing (CNC, additive manufacturing) and urgent wartime pressures continue to alter the friction-to-success ratio in a consistent direction.
